name: York
meta_description: York's beer guide: historic pubs from the Blue Bell to the Golden Fleece, riverside taprooms and bookable brewery tastings near the city.
intro_md:
York is often said to have a pub for every day of the year, and while nobody quite agrees on the count, the quality is not in doubt. The Blue Bell on Fossgate keeps its tiny Edwardian interior intact, Ye Olde Starre Inne on Stonegate has been licensed since the seventeenth century, and the Golden Fleece leans agreeably beside the Shambles.

For something between pub and shrine, the House of the Trembling Madness on Stonegate serves an enormous beer list beneath a medieval roof, while Brew York's riverside taproom brings the city's brewing up to date. The Shambles Market food stalls are handy for lining the stomach between stops.

Beyond the walls lies serious brewing country — Masham, home to Theakston and Black Sheep, makes a fine day trip.

**Don't miss**

- The unspoilt Edwardian bar at the Blue Bell
- Beers under the beams at the House of the Trembling Madness
- Brew York's taproom by the River Foss

gyg_tours.title: York: Brewery Tour, Six Tastings & Tapas
gyg_tours.summary: A 1.5-hour small-group tour of a working Yorkshire brewery at Nun Monkton near York, led by the owner and head brewer, with six beer tastings and a spread of Yorkshire tapas.
gyg_tours.description_md: Spend an evening inside a working Yorkshire brewery, guided by the owner and head brewer, Tim. You'll learn about the brewing process and see the tanks up close before settling in to sample six half-pints of beer. The tastings are paired with a spread of Yorkshire-style tapas, including local charcuterie and cheese, served in the Winehouse Café, with the option to stay on afterwards for further drinks at your own pace.
highlights: Guided tour of a working York brewery
Meet the owner and head brewer
Taste fresh beers by the tanks
Stay on afterwards for more drinks
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Nun Monkton, near York, Yorkshire (Winehouse Cafe)

gyg_tours.title: York: Cellar Door Beer Tasting
gyg_tours.summary: A relaxed cellar-door tasting at the Winehouse Café in Nun Monkton near York, pairing bottled beers with Yorkshire tapas dishes, with bronze, silver and gold tiers to choose from.
gyg_tours.description_md: A self-guided beer tasting experience in the village of Nun Monkton, near York. Guests choose award-winning beers, such as Silverheart IPA and Blackheart Stout, from a fully stocked fridge and enjoy them in the Winehouse Café or on the terrace. Rather than small measures, the tasting features full 500ml bottles paired with sharing plates of Yorkshire tapas, including local cheeses, cured meats, crackers, olives and chocolate. Sessions run Tuesday to Saturday between 11:00 and 14:00.
highlights: Self-guided beer tasting in Nun Monkton
Choose from Bronze, Silver or Gold tiers
Full 500ml bottles from a stocked fridge
Paired with Yorkshire tapas sharing plates
Local cheeses, cured meats and olives
Small groups of up to 6 people
